user_query: gmail entries in any workspace about a flights airlines in any workspace

intent.goal: find gmail content about flights/airlines across workspaces

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.body_snippet
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%flight%' OR g.subject LIKE '%airline%'
    OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%flight%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%airline%'
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%flight%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%airline%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%flight%' OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%airline%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%flight%' OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%airline%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%flight%' OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%airline%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
